create_treeviz: create a TreeViz instance to visualize a phylogenetic tree in a circular track
load_tree: load a phylogenetic tree from file, URL, string, or BioPython Tree object
highlight: highlight a target node or clade region in the phylogenetic tree
show_confidence: show confidence values on each internal node of the phylogenetic tree
marker: plot markers on target node and its descendants in the phylogenetic tree
